page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc8ae.64xlarge is an enterprise-grade bare-metal server in the ECS Bare Metal family, built on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with AMD EPYC 9T34 processors delivering 256 dedicated vCPUs with a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. System memory capacity is 768.0 GB, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 3.0 GB per core. The bare-metal architecture operates under KVM infrastructure while ensuring that CPU allocation remains entirely dedicated to the instance, eliminating multi-tenant resource contention.

The hardware configuration provides a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, accommodating high-volume internal network throughput and rapid inter-node communication. The instance does not bundle integrated local disk storage, necessitating external network-attached storage volumes for persistent data retention and operating system filesystems. Furthermore, the configuration contains no discrete GPUs, directing all compute execution entirely to the x86_64 CPU cores.

In terms of resource efficiency, the ecs.ebmc8ae.64xlarge consolidates high CPU core density within a single bare-metal deployment, reducing the orchestration overhead associated with multi-node virtual machine clusters. The 3.0 GB per core allocation aligns with compute-focused workloads rather than memory-heavy database footprints. Consequently, the instance is appropriate for highly parallel computational workloads, distributed batch processing, large-scale software compilation, backend web application aggregation, and CPU-driven ETL pipelines.
